title: LA County Raises the Progress Pride Flag in Honor of Pride Month
description:
The Los Angeles County LGBTQ+ Commission hosted a ceremonial
raising of the Progress Pride Flag to mark the beginning of Pride Month, reaffirming the County’s commitment to equity, inclusion, and visibility for the LGBTQ+ community.
